title: Slovakian Potatoes Bake
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring salted butter and salt-bake potatoes, perfect for a crowd, this lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe is a pungent and shaggy delight. It is a hearty and comforting meal that is sure to please.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and melted salted butter, tossing to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Spread half of the onion mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers, starting with the potatoes, then the remaining onion mixture, and finally another layer of potatoes.
Dot the top of the potatoes with the sour cream and sprinkle with the shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
